title: Avoid broadcasting RV change if RV didn't change
body:
Reflector calls watch cache twice on every event, first time with event and second time to update RV via `UpdateResourceVersion`. This behavior is expected and documented in reflector so this PR proposes to handle second call `UpdateResourceVersion` in more efficient manner.

Call to `UpdateResourceVersion` after an event means that RV is not expected to change. If we detect RV didn't change we can just exit early and avoid taking a write lock and broadcasting RV change that really happen.

In this PR we propose to check watch cache RV under a defensive `RLock`, while not needed it has no significant performance impact. Technically if we assume that `UpdateResourceVersion` is called from reflector loop that is the only loop updating RV the lock is not needed, but as all accesses to RV happen under lock let's be future proof. `RLock` performance is negligable as it doesn't block readers which is the main issue here.

/kind feature

```release-note
NONE
```
/assign @wojtek-t 
/cc @mborsz 


#### AI usage disclosure:

YES, used agents to analyze benchmark and notice the second broadcast.
